the development of parallel algorithms that can be implemented efficiently on shared-memory SMPs.
the development and evaluation of parallel algorithms for video parsing on a shared-memory multiprocessor.

parallel parsing of compressed videos on an SMP is a feasible proposition, and that the choice of granularity of parallelism should depend on the application.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the coarsest granularity, the GOP, is best suited to parallel video parsing.
parallel video parsing is a feasible approach for video analysis on shared-memory symmetric multiprocesors.

parallel video parsing on an SMP is feasible, and the performance is highly dependent on the level of granularity used.
parallelization of video parsing is possible, even when the granularity of parallelism is relatively coarse, and that parallelization is possible even when the video is compressed.
